layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: a proud high-medieval kingdom around the year 1250: knights and men-at-arms. Its fixed colours are deep crimson red cloth with gold-yellow trim and gold-yellow heraldic lions and crosses, over polished steel chainmail and helmets and cream linen; steel is shaded with darker blue-grey, cloth with a deeper tone of its own colour, leather is dark brown.

layers.text: Faction colours: the deep crimson red and the gold-yellow are this kingdom's fixed heraldic colours and must be clearly visible from a distance; the red is deep and rich. No team colour: nothing changes with the player.

Subject: Fighter, a chunky cute high-medieval man-at-arms with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny sturdy body: a rounded steel helmet with a gold-yellow band and a short crimson crest over a mail coif, a deep crimson red surcoat with a bold gold-yellow cross on the chest over steel chainmail sleeves, an oversized steel sword held up in the right hand, a big pointed heater shield on the left arm painted crimson red with a gold-yellow lion, dark boots; simple shapes and very few details.
